newsitem.title: ITALY: Italian politician arrested on suspicion of fraud.
newsitem.headline: Italian politician arrested on suspicion of fraud.

text.p: The deputy president of Italy's southern Campania region, Antonio Franco Girfatti, was arrested on Thursday on suspicion of involvement in a financial scandal prior to his election to public office.

Judicial sources said public prosecutors in the town of Caserta, some 20 km (13 miles) north of Naples, had ordered Girfatti's preventive detention in connection with a public health fund scandal in the early 1990s.

Girfatti, who was elected to the regional government for the centre-right Forza Italia party in 1995, is suspected of conspiracy to embezzle public funds while he was manager of a bank in Caserta which held local health authority accounts.

Girfatti, 58, became deputy president of the Campania region with responsibility for budgetary matters in 1996. The sources said Girfatti's brother and a local health administrator were also arrested on Thursday.
None of the suspects made any immediate comment on the case.
